_about: MTG's team pages. One entry per business partner. Leave a link empty ("") if they did not give it: its icon and button are then left out. Run build.py to rebuild MTG's guide and every team page. Every section on a team page opens straight away; add "open_all_sections": false to a member to use the tap-to-open sections instead. "sites" lists where a member lives: "bva" = bellveraffiliates.com/<slug>, "mtg" = musathegiant.com/bellvercards/<slug> (default: bellveraffiliates.com only).
